quote.text: Ambition means tying your well-being to what other people say or do. Self-indulgence means tying it to the things that happen to you. Sanity means tying it to your own actions.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Focus on nurturing your child by modeling disciplined actions rather than reacting to external praise or criticism, ensuring your guidance is rooted in inner integrity.
    • Remember that a child's well-being stems from your steady example—prioritize your own virtues and choices over the transient influences around you.
  • Leadership
    • True leadership is achieved when you base your decisions on your own principles rather than the fluctuating opinions of others; this helps build trust and reliability.
    • Embrace a disciplined mindset by holding yourself accountable for your actions, leading your team with the confidence of self-derived sanity and vision.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, anchor your success in diligent, thoughtful actions rather than in the unpredictable tides of market sentiment or competitor activities.
    • By taking ownership and making decisions based on clear, rational steps, you transform challenges into opportunities and maintain a steady, results-driven course.
